variants.title: XRD of silicon powder: lattice parameter and crystallite size
variants.unknown: the lattice type and parameter of silicon and its crystallite size
variants.note: Silicon has the diamond structure: face-centred, with the (200) and (222) lines missing as well, so the ratios run 3, 8, 11, 16, 19. a = 5.4309 A. The crystallite size of this powder (50 nm) is a value of this sample, not of silicon.

source.title: Lattice parameters, ICDD powder diffraction file / Wyckoff, Crystal Structures; Cu K-alpha1 1.5406 A
